scope: MEAS: independent numerical, report/source, published bar-map and visual review; not aural review.

report.finding: Reported gates, 851 notes / five staves, corrected 125.182778 s final arrival, measured display-boundary qualification and two-page 18-bar pack agree with final checks and assets.

barMap.finding: All 851 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG bar identities equal index.json bars 1–18. Both engraved pages were inspected. In particular the viola B-flat3 is visibly tied through bars 14–18 into the final fermata; its long event is not an invented final reattack or stuck MIDI note. Listen cues use seconds rather than structured bar pointers.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Pizzicato figures remain before the actual final E-flat arrival near 125.183 s, rather than being collapsed onto the earlier repeated harmony. The configured 129.5 s pitched-decay boundary, quantised to 129.49 s in the warp, is explicitly distinguished from the noisy 132.344 s container/RMS tail and from a physical bow release.

version.finding: Complete second movement in written order, bars 1–18 once, without an added pickup/repeat. Five original source staves and the tied viola pedal are retained; the bass line is not represented as a realised continuo arrangement. No gross version/cut mismatch identified.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the source edition is not asserted to be the players’ physical edition.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. The report’s per-band dB measurement was not independently recomputed; the corresponding final pitch overlay and the explicit display-boundary provenance were inspected.
